name: teleuploader-workspace
description: Workspace root for TeleUploader (kana migration). The app package lives in apps/api.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter filedrop run typecheck && pnpm --filter @teleuploader/web run typecheck
scripts.prepare: if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1 && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then lefthook install --reset-hooks-path; fi
